claims.sourceText: Clinton Digital Library collection finding aid, identifier 2006-0476-F
claims.text: The Clinton White House maintained a Roswell file - FOIA collection 2006-0476-F - containing correspondence, reports and email regarding the July 1947 Roswell crash, including the July 1995 GAO report.

claims.sourceText: Clinton Digital Library collection finding aid 2006-0476-F
claims.text: The Clinton White House's Roswell file (2006-0476-F) contains 'correspondence, reports, and email regarding a crash in Roswell, New Mexico in July 1947,' including the July 1995 GAO report, and states that 'the origin of the crashed object remains in dispute today.'

edges.note: The Clinton White House Roswell file (2006-0476-F) contains the July 1995 GAO report; the unclassified records audit is what the White House ended up holding.
